# Jinhao

> > Premium fountain pens and writing instruments from Jinhao, featuring iconic models like the X750, 159, and 886 with affordable quality craftsmanship.

Jinhao is a leading manufacturer of high-quality writing instruments, specializing in fountain pens and rollerball pens with metal bodies. The site showcases their most popular pen models and provides information for writing enthusiasts and professionals seeking affordable premium writing solutions.
